scope_note: The official stenographic report of the Third (extraordinary) Congress of People's Deputies of the RSFSR, volume I, as an image-only scan of two-page spreads. The first sitting of 28 March 1991 (printed p. 59) was read, with the contents (PDF pp. 214-215). Another deputy's description of 'Льва Пономарева, народного депутата РСФСР, координатора “Демократической России”' at the second sitting of 29 March 1991 (printed p. 71, PDF p. 36) was read but is not imported: the speaker calls the organiser a 'блок', so whether the movement or the RSFSR deputies' bloc is meant is not established, and 'координатор' is not the co-chair title. The volume has no text layer; it was searched with a word spotter and the hits read from the page images. An announcement on printed p. 59 for the 'Депутатской группе “Демократическая Россия”' (the RSFSR deputies' group) is a separate identity and is not imported. The scan is hosted by the non-official ISTNET / RSFSR-RF.RU project; the recorded identity is a raw Internet Archive capture made before the cutoff.

rows.text: At the first sitting of the Third (extraordinary) Congress of People's Deputies of the RSFSR (28 March 1991), a deputy who did not introduce himself reads the organising committee's appeal: '28 марта по заявке координационного совета движения ”Демократическая Россия”, удовлетворенной Мосгорисполкомом, должны состояться уличные шествия от площади Маяковского и Новоарбатского проспекта в центр Москвы и митинг на Манежной площади.'
rows.locator: First sitting: contents, PDF p. 214 (printed pp. 3-60); appeal, printed p. 59 (PDF p. 30, right page)

bounded_scope: Democratic Russia movement and Soyuz deputies' group observations for CLAUDE-C01-35 only. Founding, selection or election, statements, nominations, registration, leadership references by other deputies, membership statements and in-office attestations stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row.
